text:
Nina V: FYI I opened PR #4901 with a short "semi-airgap bridge" guide for Private installs. It has a compact WireGuard example, a host-bridge installer snippet, and KMS/HSM port notes. Please skim for security or networking issues.

Ravi S: Looks useful. Can you call out HSM ports 1792 and 3630 and recommend setting probe timeout to 5s+ for high-latency links? We saw failures with 1-2s probes.

Nina V: Added HSM ports and probe recommendation. Also put a one-line HSM troubleshooting checklist: time sync, certs, /var/log/hsm-plugin, and tcpdump TLS check.

Oliver K: One thing: the installer snippet uses hostNetwork: true. Add alternate installer yaml showing creation/attachment to br0 (host bridge) for isolated nodes. Customers ask for explicit bridge steps.

Nina V: Added host-bridge snippet plus a tiny systemd drop-in to set MTU 1400 on br0 (helps with tunnels).

Ravi S: Can you include a minimal nftables fallback in addition to iptables? Field sites vary.

Nina V: Added nftables example and a note about distro defaults. Also fixed a bad link to old HSM guide.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 0 warnings, 0 errors (checked 9 links) - https://ci.redwood/links/4901

Oliver K: LGTM from docs side. Approving after CI. Suggest follow-up PR for IPSec concentrator example (customers sometimes prefer hardware VPN).

Nina V: Will open follow-up PR post-merge. Thanks :rocket:
